overview_description.description: Tripdizer is a travel tech startup based in Egypt. Tripdizer offers an end to end solution by offering  personalized itineraries to travelers that resonate with their budget and interests, using a homegrown algorithm integrated with AI, to ensure an optimized travel experience based on the inputs of thousands of other travelers.
